## Deck Goal
Teach Year-2 physics students to turn a familiar projectile target condition into a residual f(theta)=0, interpret residual signs and a graphical zero crossing, trace scaffolded bisection and Newton updates, apply one supplied residual stopping rule, validate by substitution, and explain the physical meaning and unit of the root.
